business_overview.statement: Residential plumbing and heating firm with 6 engineers and 2 office staff, mostly boiler servicing, repairs and bathroom refits
Priority for the next year is more planned servicing contracts and fewer one-off emergency call-outs

systems_in_use.statement: Jobs are tracked in a shared spreadsheet, invoices in Xero, bookings in a shared Google Calendar
Calls go to a single office landline with a basic voicemail; email is a shared Gmail inbox

enquiries_communication.statement: Calls during jobs or after 5pm go to voicemail and some are never returned
enquiries_communication.staff_time: about 1 hour a day listening to and returning voicemails
enquiries_communication.workaround: Engineers sometimes take calls on their own mobiles
enquiries_communication.impact: Customer believes some new jobs go to competitors

enquiries_communication.statement: Website form enquiries arrive in the shared inbox and can wait a day for a reply
enquiries_communication.errors_rework: Occasionally two people reply to the same enquiry

sales_quoting.statement: Quotes for refits are typed up in a word processor from the engineer's site notes
sales_quoting.errors_rework: Prices sometimes copied from an out-of-date price list
sales_quoting.workaround: Owner re-checks large quotes before they are sent

sales_quoting.statement: Nobody follows up quotes that get no response
sales_quoting.impact: Customer does not know how many quotes are lost this way

bookings_scheduling.statement: Engineers' diaries are juggled by phone when an emergency job comes in
bookings_scheduling.errors_rework: Double bookings happen about twice a month
bookings_scheduling.workaround: A paper whiteboard in the office mirrors the calendar

manual_duplicated_tasks.statement: Completed jobs are re-keyed from the spreadsheet into Xero to raise invoices
manual_duplicated_tasks.errors_rework: Missed or duplicated invoices found at month end

manual_duplicated_tasks.statement: Annual service reminders are sent by hand from a list

data_integrations.statement: Customer details exist separately in the spreadsheet, Xero and the phone contacts, and often disagree
data_integrations.errors_rework: Invoices sent to old addresses a few times a quarter
data_integrations.cost: Owner estimates one or two unpaid invoices a quarter, around 300 GBP each

pain_points_bottlenecks.statement: Month-end invoicing is the biggest bottleneck and delays cash coming in
pain_points_bottlenecks.impact: Payment typically arrives 3-4 weeks after the job

pain_points_bottlenecks.statement: The office laptop holding the job spreadsheet has no backup
pain_points_bottlenecks.workaround: Owner occasionally copies it to a USB stick

existing_automations.statement: Xero sends automatic payment reminders; nothing else is automated and no AI tools are used

opportunities_constraints.statement: Owner would most like enquiries and bookings to run without the office chasing them
Quotes and any message about price must be approved by the owner before sending
Budget is limited this year and the team wants to keep Xero
opportunities_constraints.cost: Owner mentioned up to 150 GBP a month for new software

findings.title: Missed calls and slow enquiry replies
findings.detail: The customer states that out-of-hours and on-job calls go to voicemail and some are never returned, and form enquiries can wait a day.
findings.recommendation: Map the enquiry journey, then trial call capture with a missed-call text-back and a shared enquiry queue; keep pricing replies for human approval.
findings.likely_cause: No cover for calls while the office is busy or closed
findings.business_impact: Customer believes some new work goes to competitors (not measured)

findings.title: Job, scheduling and invoicing data live in disconnected tools
findings.detail: Jobs are tracked in a spreadsheet and re-keyed into Xero, customer details disagree between systems, and diaries are juggled by phone.
findings.recommendation: Assess a job-management system that integrates with Xero, within the stated budget, before considering any automation on top.
findings.business_impact: Stated rework, double bookings and delayed invoicing

findings.title: Job spreadsheet has no backup
findings.detail: The customer states the laptop holding the job spreadsheet is not backed up.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the current setup on site, then put managed backup in place for business data.

findings.title: No follow-up on quotes or service reminders
findings.detail: Unanswered quotes are not followed up and annual service reminders are sent by hand, while the stated priority is more planned servicing.
findings.recommendation: Set up owner-approved quote follow-up and automated service reminders to support recurring servicing work.
